theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_cri_setLIntegral_congr_off_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (G D D' : Set (Euclidean N)) (f g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), NullMeasurableSet G μ → μ (D \ G) = 0 → μ (D' \ G) = 0 → (∀ x ∈ G, x ∈ D ↔ x ∈ D') → (∀ x ∈ G, f x = g x) → ∫⁻ x in D, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in D', g x ∂μ
